semiconductor_relevance: High — Unites Systems a.s. specializes in the development and manufacturing of advanced testing equipment for semiconductors, making it a key player in the semiconductor testing sector.
summary: Unites Systems a.s. develops and manufactures automated test equipment (ATE) and provides comprehensive testing services for semiconductors. Their innovative solutions cater to various industries, including automotive and aerospace, ensuring high-quality testing for power discrete semiconductors.
capabilities: P913 power semiconductor tester with DC and avalanche test capabilities
Effitest P-Series high-speed test system for mass production of power discrete semiconductors
Dedicated test and measurement systems for SiC, GaN, Ga2O3, IGBT, and MOS FET

regional_presence.Czech Republic: The company is based in Valasske Mezirici, Czech Republic, where it develops and manufactures its testing equipment.
